text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
“You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
“You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
“For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
“Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”
Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
May the LORD repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.
A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
“Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”
Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”
For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
For Ezra had set his heart to seek the LORD’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
“As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
“Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
“Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
“I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
“Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
I love you, LORD, my strength.
In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
“I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
“Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
If you love me, keep my commandments.
For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
“This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Let all that you do be done in love.
Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
Always rejoice.
You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
Pray without ceasing.
I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
But godliness with contentment is great gain.
The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
“Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
We love him, because he first loved us.
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
“I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
